Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
Are you open on Saturdays? And can I use insurance?

Yes, we are open on Saturdays from nine in the morning to seven in the evening. As for insurance, it depends on the type of injury and your situation. Our staff can explain the details when you visit. Is there anything else I can assist you with right now?
